scope: Exam view at 390 x 844, light and dark themes
observed: Fixed-width right palette occupies almost the entire viewport; question body is reduced to a narrow clipped strip. Confirmed by screenshot, not only overflow heuristics.
expected: Question and answer choices remain readable and accessible on narrow screens while retaining navigation controls.
qualification: Representative visual confirmation of a shared layout defect; per-question overflow signals are not individually certified defects. Internal audit toolbar covers the bottom and must not be confused with production UI.
